newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Libya's Gaddafi says Hebron deal a trick.
newsitem.headline: Libya's Gaddafi says Hebron deal a trick.

text.p: Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi on Thursday said a deal on Palestinian self-rule in the West Bank town of Hebron was a trick because the Israeli army will continue to encircle the city.

Gaddafi said in a statement reported by the official Libyan news agency JANA: "The Israeli army pullout from the streets of Hebron doesn't mean the liberation of the city because it (the Israeli army) will remain encircling it from outside."

"It will also continue to occupy the Palestinian lands and control the borders of Palestine with Egypt and Jordan. The occupation remain, Hebron is still occupied, the (Jewish) settlements are continuing," he added.
JANA, monitored in Tunis, also quoted Gaddafi as saying that he regretted that Arabs welcomed the Hebron deal as victory, when it is only a "trick".
"The Palestinian and Arab citizens must not believe this lie," he added.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat bowed to weeks of U.S. pressure and sealed the accord at a late-night summit on Tuesday and agreed on a timeframe for further Israeli pullbacks in the West Bank.
Under the accord, Israeli troops will hand over 80 percent of the city and the agreement provides for joint patrols by israreli and Palestinian forces.
